market: Europe Modified Silane (MS Polymer) Sealants Market
market_definition: Modified Silane (MS Polymer) Sealants comprises silane-terminated polymer sealants designed to combine elastic sealing performance with adhesion to common construction and industrial substrates. The scope covers sealant formulations rather than MS polymer adhesives sold specifically for bonding. By Formulation • One-Component • Two-Component By Performance • Low-Modulus • High-Modulus • Paintable • Weather-Resistant By Form • Cartridge • Sausage • Pail / Bulk By Application • Construction Joints • Facade and Roofing • Flooring Joints • Transport Sealing By End Use • Building and Construction • Automotive • Marine • Industrial By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: MS polymer adhesives classified and marketed for bonding; silicone, polyurethane and acrylic sealants; primers and application equipment sold separately. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
